title: Balanced Logistic Regression
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of class_weight, decision scores, and thresholding, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in credit-card-fraud-detection.
learning_objectives: Explain class_weight, decision scores, and thresholding in plain language and connect it to src/train.py.
Trace one input through the balanced logistic regression stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the balanced logistic regression stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for class_weight, decision scores, and thresholding.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
